experiment: C - bounded self-evolution on Single, SWE-bench Lite 3 dev + 3 validation (collection plan section 7)
flow: dev: one A/A single pair per dev case (two runs each)
background host imports the dev evaluation runs (same host code the TUI uses), clusters by mechanism across >=2 sources, proposes at most 2 suggestions
a person selects at most one suggestion or rejects all
validation: baseline vs candidate text_candidate, 3 cases x 2 repetitions, first arm alternating
adoption_gate: no validation case where candidate fails and baseline passes; and pass count increases, or whole-tree token ratio <= 0.95 with tool-call increase <= 2
stability_definition: every dev run has a detection record; each suggestion cites original evidence from >=2 runs; candidate passes the original whitelist admission; verdict comes from the original comparison
isolation: the analysis model sees only structural detections of dev runs; no validation case, hidden test or scorer
network: direct: paired plans for runs; the suggest step clears *_PROXY and installs ProxyHandler({}) in its own process
